answer: Parjad Minooei is a Software Engineer who builds full-stack web applications. This portfolio showcases projects, blog posts, a mock interview experience, and an interactive CLI/OS mode. Browse the Projects and About pages to learn more.
You can reach Parjad through the Contact page on this site or via LinkedIn at linkedin.com/in/parjadminooei.

Parjad works with React, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, Python, and modern frontend tooling including Vite, Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion. Check the Skills section and individual project pages for more detail.
The Projects page lists featured work with descriptions, tech stacks, and links. Each project card opens a detail view with more context.
Parjad's professional experience and background are summarized on the About page and in the AI knowledge base used by this assistant. For hiring conversations, try the Mock Interview page.
Education details are available on the About page. Ask a more specific question if you need a particular program or credential.
If a resume link is available on the site, you'll find it on the About or Contact page. You can also connect on LinkedIn for a direct conversation.
GitHub activity and stats are integrated into this portfolio. Visit the GitHub section or Parjad's GitHub profile for repositories and contributions.
LeetCode stats are displayed live on the site. Open the LeetCode section from the navigation to see solved problems and rankings.
For hiring or collaboration, use the Contact page or LinkedIn. The Mock Interview page lets recruiters practice technical questions in character.
Location and timezone details are on the About and Contact pages if listed. Reach out directly for the most current availability.
The Blog page lists technical articles and write-ups. Each post includes full content and shareable links.
This site includes an interactive CLI at /cli and a desktop OS experience at /os with apps, a file system, and terminal commands. Try `help` in the terminal for commands.
I'm the portfolio AI assistant. I can answer questions about Parjad's background, projects, skills, and site features. Browse Projects, Blog, About, or Contact—or ask me something specific.
The Mock Interview at /interview lets recruiters ask technical questions to an AI playing Parjad. Toggle recruiter mode for a higher daily question limit.
The Stats page includes an AI complexity analyzer. Paste code to get time and space complexity with explanations. Results are cached to save API usage.
The Stats page shows live GitHub and LeetCode metrics plus tools like the complexity analyzer. Visit /stats from the navigation.
LQFT Benchmark is an interactive demo comparing persistent tree structures — CRUD, memory density, and complexity views. Open /projects/lqftBenchmark to explore it.
ParjadOS is the desktop GUI at /os with apps, a taskbar, file explorer, and terminal. Type `gui` or `startx` from CLI to boot it.
AI features have daily limits per visitor to keep the site sustainable. FAQ and cached answers are free — only new Gemini responses count toward limits.
